name: Pharaoh enslaves the Israelites with harsh labor
summary: A new king who does not remember Joseph fears Israel's growing numbers and forces them into hard labor.

name: Pharaoh orders Hebrew midwives to kill baby boys
summary: Pharaoh secretly instructs the Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah to kill every son born to Israelite mothers.

name: Shiphrah and Puah defy Pharaoh's order
summary: The midwives fear God and let the baby boys live, then tell Pharaoh the Hebrew women give birth too quickly for them to intervene.

name: Pharaoh commands Hebrew infant boys drowned in the Nile
summary: After the midwives refuse to obey, Pharaoh orders all his people to throw every newborn Hebrew boy into the Nile.

name: Moses is born and hidden by his mother
summary: A Levite couple has a son and Jochebed hides him for three months to protect him from Pharaoh's decree.

name: Moses is placed in a basket on the Nile
summary: Unable to hide him any longer, Jochebed sets Moses adrift in a papyrus basket among the reeds while Miriam watches, until Pharaoh's daughter comes down to the river and finds him.

name: Pharaoh's daughter adopts Moses as her son
summary: Pharaoh's daughter has Jochebed nurse the baby, then takes him as her own son and raises him in the Egyptian royal household.

name: Moses kills an Egyptian and flees to Midian
summary: As an adult, Moses kills an Egyptian who was beating a Hebrew and, when it becomes known, flees to Midian to escape Pharaoh.

name: Moses marries Zipporah at a well in Midian
summary: Moses helps the daughters of the priest of Midian at a well, and their father Jethro gives Moses his daughter Zipporah in marriage.

name: The king of Egypt dies and God remembers his covenant
summary: Years pass, the king of Egypt dies, and Israel groans under slavery and cries out; God hears them and remembers his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

name: God appears to Moses in the burning bush
summary: While shepherding Jethro's flock at Horeb, Moses sees a bush on fire that is not consumed and turns aside to look.

name: God commissions Moses to deliver Israel
summary: God tells Moses that he has seen Israel's suffering and sends him to Pharaoh to bring the people out of Egypt.

name: God reveals his name to Moses
summary: When Moses asks what name to give Israel, God answers "I AM WHO I AM" and identifies himself as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

name: God gives Moses miraculous signs to perform
summary: God turns Moses' staff into a snake and makes his hand leprous and clean again as proof for Israel that God sent him.

name: Moses objects that he is slow of speech
summary: Moses protests that he is not a skilled speaker, and God grows angry but agrees to give him Aaron as a spokesman.

name: God appoints Aaron to speak for Moses
summary: God tells Moses that his brother Aaron is already on his way to meet him and will speak to the people on his behalf.

name: Moses and Aaron reunite at the mountain of God
summary: Moses leaves Midian with his family, and Aaron meets him at the mountain of God (Horeb), where Moses tells him all that the LORD has said.

name: Moses and Aaron gather Israel's elders in Egypt
summary: Back in Egypt, Aaron speaks to the elders of Israel and performs the signs, and the people believe and worship.

name: Moses and Aaron demand Pharaoh release Israel
summary: Moses and Aaron tell Pharaoh that the LORD demands he let Israel go into the wilderness to worship, and Pharaoh refuses.

name: Pharaoh increases the Israelites' labor burden
summary: Pharaoh punishes the request by forcing the Israelites to gather their own straw while still producing the same quota of bricks.

name: God renews his covenant promise to Moses
summary: After Moses complains that conditions have worsened, God reaffirms his covenant name and his promise to bring Israel out of slavery into the land.

name: Moses and Aaron are commissioned again to confront Pharaoh
summary: Despite Moses' discouragement, God sends him and Aaron back to Pharaoh to demand Israel's release.

name: Aaron's staff swallows the magicians' staffs
summary: Aaron's staff becomes a serpent before Pharaoh and swallows the staffs of Egypt's magicians, yet Pharaoh's heart stays hard.

name: The Nile turns to blood
summary: Aaron strikes the Nile with his staff and the river and all its water turn to blood, killing the fish.

name: Frogs overrun the land of Egypt
summary: Frogs swarm out of the Nile and fill Egyptian houses until Pharaoh begs Moses to remove them and briefly agrees to let Israel go.

name: The dust becomes gnats throughout Egypt
summary: Aaron strikes the dust and it turns to gnats on people and animals across Egypt, a plague even Pharaoh's magicians cannot copy.

name: Swarms of flies invade Egypt but spare Goshen
summary: Dense swarms of flies fill Egyptian homes while the land of Goshen, where Israel lives, is untouched.

name: A plague kills the Egyptians' livestock
summary: A severe plague kills the horses, donkeys, camels, herds, and flocks of Egypt while none of Israel's animals die.

name: Boils break out on the Egyptians
summary: Moses throws soot into the air and painful boils break out on the Egyptians and their animals throughout the land.

name: Hail devastates the crops and livestock of Egypt
summary: A destructive hailstorm mixed with fire strikes Egypt, flattening crops and killing people and animals left in the open.

name: Locusts strip Egypt's remaining crops
summary: A vast swarm of locusts covers the land and eats every plant the hail left standing.

name: Darkness covers the land of Egypt for three days
summary: A thick darkness settles over Egypt for three days while Israel's homes remain filled with light.

name: God warns Moses of the coming death of the firstborn
shortName: God warns of the firstborn's death
summary: Before the final plague, God tells Moses that every firstborn in Egypt will die and Pharaoh will finally drive Israel out.

name: God institutes the Passover meal and instructions
summary: God gives Moses and Aaron detailed instructions for the Passover meal and the blood on the doorframes that will protect Israel's homes.

name: The tenth plague strikes every firstborn in Egypt
summary: At midnight the LORD strikes down every firstborn in Egypt, from Pharaoh's household to the prisoner's, and Pharaoh finally releases Israel.

name: Israel departs Egypt from Rameses
summary: The Israelites, roughly six hundred thousand men plus women and children, leave Rameses for Succoth after four hundred thirty years in Egypt.

name: God commands the consecration of the firstborn
summary: God instructs Moses that every firstborn male among Israel's people and animals belongs to the LORD as a reminder of the exodus.

name: A pillar of cloud and fire leads Israel
shortName: The pillar of cloud and fire
summary: God leads Israel away from the shorter Philistine road and guides the people with a visible pillar of cloud by day and fire by night.

name: Pharaoh pursues Israel with his army
summary: Pharaoh changes his mind and chases Israel with chariots, trapping the people between his army and the sea.

name: Israel crosses the Red Sea on dry ground
summary: Moses stretches out his hand, the LORD drives back the sea with a strong wind, and Israel walks across on dry ground.

name: The sea closes over Pharaoh's army
summary: As the Egyptian army follows into the seabed, the waters return and drown Pharaoh's entire chariot force.
